Commands in `prepare()`, `build()`, `check()`, and `package()` are not executed due to the `--noprepare` and `--nobuild` flags, so they are out of scope for this narrow gate.

Thus, running `makepkg --nobuild --nodeps --noprepare` and `makepkg --printsrcinfo` on this PKGBUILD is safe, as it only involves cloning a public, expected upstream repository and sourcing benign version logic.
</details>
